subject: english
question:
Choose the most appropriate antonym of the underlined word.

Venus was the quiet one: __**pensive **__and observant of everything around her.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Ignorant**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"pensive"** means deeply or seriously thoughtful, often with a tinge of sadness. (विचारमग्न)

 
 
• **Example: **She sat by the window, pensive, watching the rain fall outside.
 
 
 
• **"Ignorant"** refers to someone who is lacking in knowledge, awareness, or information about something. (अज्ञानी)
 
 
• **Example: **He remained ignorant of the changes happening around him because he never read the news.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'pensive'** is **'ignorant'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Ignorant**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Thoughtful** (विचारशील): Engaged in deep or serious thought.

 
 
• **Example:** He gave a thoughtful reply after considering all aspects of the situation.
 
 
 
• **Reflective** (चिंतनशील): Capable of or engaged in deep thought.
 
 
• **Example:** After the meeting, she became reflective about her career choices.
 
 
 
• **Pondering** (विचारशील): Thinking deeply about something.
 
 
• **Example:** He was pondering over the decision for hours.
 
 

3b:T900,

The correct answer is: **Option 3**.
